abandon: leave behind and stop using or doing
They abandoned the plan when costs rose.
a feeling of freedom from restraint
abstract: existing as an idea rather than as a physical thing
a short summary of a longer text
Read the abstract before the paper.
take away or separate from something
The study abstracts the main factors from the data.
accurate: The map is accurate to within a metre.
achieve: successfully reach a goal through effort
She achieved her goal of finishing early.
affect: have an influence on or change
He affected an air of calm.
analyze: examine something closely to understand its parts
We analyzed the results by group.
ancient: belonging to the very distant past
Ancient Rome built roads across Europe.
apply: put to use for a purpose
Apply the formula to each case.
argue: give reasons for or against something
The author argues that memory is reconstructive.
assume: take to be true without proof
take on a responsibility or role
She assumed the role of chair.
